verdict.rationale: Outlook has extensive developer docs for Microsoft Graph, so asking about agent-oriented docs is a fair question. However, hands-on probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404), no markdown versions of doc pages (HTTP 404) and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Nothing in the pack shows docs published in an agent-oriented form.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
